# All In Fitness

> Blessington's best equipped gym (Co. Wicklow, Ireland). Machines from industry-leading brands including Gymleco, Life Fitness, Cybex, Atlantis, Primal, Concept2 & Evolve. From brand new to vintage & restored, we have some very nice pieces that you don't see in the average gym.

## Opening hours
- Monday – Friday: 06:00–21:00
- Saturday: 08:00–15:00
- Sunday: 08:00–13:00

## Memberships
- Monthly: €59/month. Full gym and all classes; €20 joining fee; 3-month minimum, 2 weeks' notice to cancel.
- Annual: €525/year. Full gym and all classes; One payment, no direct debits; Works out under €44 a month.
- 3 Months: €195/3 months. Full gym and all classes; One payment, no direct debits; Nothing to cancel.
- Student and OAP rates: €169 for 3 months or €425 for a year. Buy any membership through Glofox.

## Training
Proper coaching built around you, from your first lift to match day.
- Small group training
- One-to-one personal training with our trainers
- Strength & conditioning for teams
- Online programmes

## Classes
Something for everyone, whatever your level. Book online, or call us or ask at the desk for what's on.
- All In Strength
- All In Conditioning
- All In Hybrid
- HYROX
- Men's Boxing
- Ladies' Boxing

## Questions
### Where is All In Fitness?
Unit 2, Burgage House, Burgage, Blessington, Co. Wicklow, W91 V065. Parking on site is free. Call us on 045 900 372.

### How much is a gym membership?
€59 a month (plus a €20 joining fee, with a 3-month minimum), €195 for 3 months, or €525 for a year. Student and OAP memberships are €169 for 3 months or €425 for a year. Every membership includes the full gym and all classes.

### Do you offer personal training?
Yes. One-to-one personal training is run by the trainers who work at the gym, so call us or ask at the desk and we'll put you in touch. The gym also runs small group training sessions.

### What classes do you run?
All In Strength, All In Conditioning, All In Hybrid, HYROX, Men's Boxing and Ladies' Boxing. Class times change through the year, so call us or ask at the desk for what's on.

### Do you train sports teams?
Yes. We run strength and conditioning for local GAA and soccer teams.

### How do I join?
Buy a membership online through Glofox, or call in to the gym. You register on Glofox, which is also where you fill in the gym's forms and book.
